findings.rationale: The lifecycle report marks tf_iam_open as an open_identity exposure because aws_iam_policy iam-open grants Action=* on Resource=*.
The same lifecycle record identifies the attached principal as able to act on every resource because the policy sets Resource=*.
The lifecycle report pairs the wildcard IAM policy with tf_s3_public_access, whose aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket is reachable without authentication.
findings.traces_to: tf_iam_open Statement[0] (Action/Resource '*') chained with tf_s3_public_access aws_s3_bucket.public_bucket acl = 'public-read'
